claims.meaning: The work is a creative audio interpretation of convergence: distinct signals preserve separateness before resolving into a shared harmonic and spatial field. It is an expression-layer work, not a representation of current Runtime, Host, Research, or organizational state.
allowedWording: distinct signals converge without erasing their initial separation
avoid: this audio encodes or proves current Runtime, Host, Research, or organizational state
technical decoding or waveform inspection proves universal listener preference
the sonic metaphor is itself factual system authority
